home.q_createMatch: How do I create a new match?
home.a_createMatch: Tap the "New Match" button and choose between Official Match (full features, cloud sync) or Test Match (simplified, for practice).
home.tip_createMatch: Tap this button to create a new match. Choose Official for real games or Test for practice.
home.q_officialVsTest: What is the difference between Official and Test matches?
home.a_officialVsTest: Official matches require complete rosters (6+ players per team), match officials, and signatures. Data syncs to the cloud. Test matches have simplified setup with no roster or signature requirements and store data locally only.
home.q_continueMatch: How do I continue a paused match?
home.a_continueMatch: Tap "Continue" on the active match card to resume scoring exactly where you left off.
home.tip_continueMatch: Tap here to resume your in-progress match.
home.q_deleteMatch: How do I delete a match?
home.a_deleteMatch: Tap "Delete" on the match card. Official matches require the game PIN for deletion to prevent accidental removal.
home.tip_deleteMatch: Tap here to delete the current match.
home.q_restoreMatch: How do I restore a match from backup?
home.a_restoreMatch: Tap "Restore Match" and choose Cloud Backup (enter Game # and PIN) or Local Backup (select a .json backup file from your device).
home.tip_restoreMatch: Tap here to restore a match from a cloud or local backup.
home.q_settings: How do I change the language or settings?
home.a_settings: Use the hamburger menu (☰) in the top-right corner to access language selection, display scale, fullscreen mode, and other options.

matchSetup.q_matchInfo: How do I fill in match information?
matchSetup.a_matchInfo: Tap the Match Info card to enter game number, date, time, city, hall, and league. All fields are required for official matches.
matchSetup.tip_matchInfo: This card contains all basic match information. Tap each field to edit.
matchSetup.q_teamColors: How do I set team names and colors?
matchSetup.a_teamColors: Enter team names in the team cards. Tap the color swatch next to each team name to pick their jersey color. You can also set short names (max 8 characters) for display.
matchSetup.tip_teamColors: Tap the color swatch to change the team color, or edit the team name directly.
matchSetup.q_addPlayers: How do I add players to a team roster?
matchSetup.a_addPlayers: In the team roster section, enter the jersey number (1-99), last name, and first name. Optionally add date of birth. Tap "Add" or press Enter to add the player to the roster.
matchSetup.tip_addPlayers: Enter player details here and tap Add. Each team needs at least 6 players (not counting liberos).
matchSetup.q_importPdf: How do I import a roster from PDF?
matchSetup.a_importPdf: Tap "Import PDF" and select the official roster PDF file. The app will automatically parse player names and numbers from the document.
matchSetup.tip_importPdf: Tap here to import player data from an official roster PDF file.
matchSetup.a_liberos: In the roster list, check the L1 or L2 checkbox next to a player to designate them as Libero 1 or Libero 2. Each team can have up to 2 liberos.
matchSetup.tip_liberos: Check L1 or L2 to designate this player as a libero.
matchSetup.q_captain: How do I set the team captain?
matchSetup.a_captain: In the roster list, tap the captain star icon next to a player to designate them as team captain. Only one player per team can be captain.
matchSetup.tip_captain: Tap the star icon to designate this player as the team captain.
matchSetup.q_benchOfficials: How do I add bench officials?
matchSetup.a_benchOfficials: Scroll down in the team card to the Bench Officials section. Add the coach, assistant coaches, physiotherapist, and medic with their names.
matchSetup.tip_benchOfficials: Enter bench official names here: coach, assistant coaches, physiotherapist, medic.
matchSetup.q_proceed: How do I proceed to the coin toss?
matchSetup.a_proceed: Complete all required sections (all cards show green checkmarks), then tap "Proceed to Coin Toss" at the bottom. All required fields must be filled for official matches.
matchSetup.tip_proceed: Tap here to proceed to the coin toss. All required fields must be completed first.

coinToss.q_record: How do I record the coin toss?
coinToss.a_record: After conducting the physical coin toss with team captains, select which team won the toss by tapping their name.
coinToss.tip_record: Select the team that won the coin toss here.
coinToss.q_serve: How do I select which team serves first?
coinToss.a_serve: After selecting the toss winner, choose whether the winning team wants to serve or receive first.
coinToss.tip_serve: Choose serve or receive for the toss-winning team.
coinToss.q_sides: How do I choose court sides?
coinToss.a_sides: Tap the court diagram to assign which team starts on which side (left or right).
coinToss.tip_sides: Assign teams to their starting court sides.
coinToss.q_start: How do I start the match?
coinToss.a_start: After all choices are confirmed (toss winner, serve/receive, court sides), tap "Start Match" to proceed to the scoreboard.
coinToss.tip_start: Tap here to start the match and begin scoring.

scoreboard.q_startRally: How do I start the first rally?
scoreboard.a_startRally: First, set both teams' lineups by tapping each court position and assigning a player. Then tap "Start Set" for the first rally, and "Start Rally" for subsequent rallies.
scoreboard.tip_startRally: Tap here to start the rally. Both lineups must be set before the first rally.
scoreboard.q_awardPoint: How do I award a point?
scoreboard.a_awardPoint: After starting a rally, tap the point button for the team that scored. The button for each team is on their side of the scoreboard. Points can only be awarded during an active rally.
scoreboard.tip_awardPoint: Tap the team's point button after a rally to award them the point.
scoreboard.q_timeout: How do I call a timeout?
scoreboard.a_timeout: Tap the timeout counter (TO: 0/2) for the team requesting the timeout. Timeouts can only be called between rallies. Each team gets 2 timeouts per set, lasting 30 seconds each.
scoreboard.tip_timeout: Tap here to call a timeout for this team. Only available between rallies.
scoreboard.q_substitution: How do I make a substitution?
scoreboard.a_substitution: Tap a court player to select them, then choose "Substitute" and pick a bench player. Alternatively, drag and drop a court player to a bench player (or vice versa). On mobile, long-press to start dragging.
scoreboard.tip_substitution: Tap a player to select them for substitution, or drag and drop between court and bench.
scoreboard.q_libero: How do I enter or exit the libero?
scoreboard.a_libero: Drag the libero from the bench to a back-row position (I, V, or VI). A point must be awarded before the libero can enter. The libero can only replace back-row players.
scoreboard.tip_libero: Drag the libero from the bench to a back-row position (I, V, VI).
scoreboard.q_undo: How do I undo an action?
scoreboard.a_undo: Tap the "Undo" button to reverse the last action. You can undo multiple times to reverse several actions. The undo history is preserved until the set ends.
scoreboard.tip_undo: Tap Undo to reverse the last action. Repeat for multiple undos.
scoreboard.q_sanction: How do I record a sanction?
scoreboard.a_sanction: Tap on a player, then select the sanction type: Warning (yellow), Penalty (red, point to opponent), Expulsion (red+yellow, player leaves for set), or Disqualification (red+yellow, player leaves match).
scoreboard.tip_sanction: Tap a player to select them, then choose a sanction type from the menu.
scoreboard.q_lineup: How do I set the initial lineup?
scoreboard.a_lineup: Before the first rally, tap each court position (I through VI) and assign a player by selecting their jersey number. Both teams must have all 6 positions filled.
scoreboard.tip_lineup: Tap each position on the court to assign a player from the roster.
scoreboard.a_shortcuts: Enable keyboard shortcuts in Settings. Default keys: Left/Right arrow for points, Q/P for timeouts, Z for undo, Space for start rally. You can customize all keys in Settings → Keyboard Shortcuts.
scoreboard.q_setEnd: What happens at the end of a set?
scoreboard.a_setEnd: When a team reaches 25 points (15 in set 5) with a 2-point lead, the set ends automatically. The score display will show the final set result.
scoreboard.tip_setEnd: The score display shows current points and set results.
scoreboard.a_set5: Set 5 is played to 15 points (still need 2-point lead). Teams switch courts at 8 points. A new coin toss determines serve and sides.
scoreboard.tip_set5: The set indicator shows which set you're in and previous results.
scoreboard.q_changeDecision: How do I change a scoring decision?
scoreboard.a_changeDecision: Use "Undo" to reverse the last point. Then award the point to the correct team. For older decisions, use Manual Adjustments from the menu.
scoreboard.tip_changeDecision: Tap Undo to reverse a scoring decision.

matchEnd.q_reviewResults: How do I review the match results?
matchEnd.a_reviewResults: The results table shows set-by-set scores, timeouts used, substitutions per set, set durations, and total match duration.
matchEnd.tip_reviewResults: This table shows the complete match results and statistics.
matchEnd.q_signatures: How do I collect final signatures?
matchEnd.a_signatures: Tap each signature field to open the signing pad. Collect in order: Team A Captain, Team B Captain, Scorer, 2nd Referee (if present), 1st Referee.
matchEnd.tip_signatures: Tap a signature field to open the signing pad and collect the signature.
matchEnd.q_exportPdf: How do I export the scoresheet as PDF?
matchEnd.a_exportPdf: Tap "Generate PDF" to create the official scoresheet in PDF format. The PDF includes all match data, scores, and signatures.
matchEnd.tip_exportPdf: Tap here to generate the official scoresheet PDF.
matchEnd.q_downloadJson: How do I download the match data?
matchEnd.a_downloadJson: Tap "Download JSON" to save the complete match data as a backup file. This file can be used to restore the match later.
matchEnd.tip_downloadJson: Tap here to download the complete match data as a JSON backup file.
matchEnd.q_reopenSet: How do I reopen a set to make corrections?
matchEnd.a_reopenSet: Tap "Reopen Last Set" to go back to scoring mode. Warning: this will clear all collected signatures, which will need to be collected again.
matchEnd.tip_reopenSet: Tap here to reopen the last set. Warning: all signatures will be cleared.

manualAdjustments.a_editScores: Select the "Scores" tab to view and modify set scores for any completed set. Adjust the scores for each team as needed.
manualAdjustments.tip_editScores: Select this tab to edit set scores.
manualAdjustments.q_editTeams: How do I edit team information?
manualAdjustments.a_editTeams: Select the "Teams & Players" tab to modify team names, player details, add/remove players, and update bench officials.
manualAdjustments.tip_editTeams: Select this tab to edit teams, players, and officials.
manualAdjustments.q_editEvents: How do I edit past events?
manualAdjustments.a_editEvents: Select the "Timeouts & Subs" tab to review and modify the event log, including timeouts, substitutions, and sanctions.
manualAdjustments.tip_editEvents: Select this tab to edit timeouts, substitutions, and sanctions.
manualAdjustments.q_saveChanges: How do I save my changes?
manualAdjustments.a_saveChanges: Tap "Save Changes" at the bottom to apply all modifications. An audit log of changes is automatically created.
manualAdjustments.tip_saveChanges: Tap here to save all your changes.
